shulkerfetch.gui.title: Shulker AutoFetch Settings
config.comment.shulkerfetchopengui: Hotkey that opens the Shulker AutoFetch settings screen.
config.comment.shulkerfetchenabled: Master switch for the whole mod.
config.comment.shulkerfetchproplace: Also fetch from shulker boxes while Easy Place uses an accurate placement protocol (V3 / V2 / Slabs only).
config.comment.shulkerfetcheasyplace: Fetch from shulker boxes when Litematica's Easy Place needs an item.
config.comment.shulkerfetchwheelclick: Fetch from shulker boxes when picking a schematic block (wheel click / pick block hotkeys) and the item is missing.
config.comment.shulkerfetchdebuglog: Write fetch details to the game log.
